ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart comparing wheat crops in the five countries of the United States, Canada, China, Denmark, and India. Under each letter A, B, C, D, and E there are three bars, respectively representing area, yield per unit area, and total output. The three values of group B are approximately: wheat area 14 million hm², yield per unit area 2263 kg/hm², and total output 3183. Then reason: among the five countries limited by the question stem, the combination of a wheat sown area of about 14 million hm², a relatively low yield per unit area of about 2.3 t/hm², and a total output of more than thirty million tons conforms to the characteristics of Canadian wheat production. Therefore B represents Canada.
